name: Whispers of the Arcane
source:
Bound by a mysterious ring and called to a higher purpose by the goddess Aphrodite, you must return to your hometown and investigate the strange happenings at Saigetsu Private Academy. You are thrust into a world of arcane forces, forgotten deities, and spiritual echoes that bleed into the waking world. As you do battle with the forces around you, temptation will arise, seeking to corrupt the pure intentions of those around you. Behind Saigetsu’s serene halls lies a secret: portals to another realm, and a power that awakens only when hearts are tested. As the line between love and desire blur, reality begins to fracture. You must unravel a mystery older than memory, before the veil between worlds tears for good.​
